result.title: SilverSpoon-KD: A General-Purpose Toolkit for Knowledge Distillation
result.summary: Knowledge distillation transfers deep learning representations from a teacher model to a student model, typically reducing model size or inference cost. However, knowledge distillation tooling has not kept pace with the breadth of research methods: existing toolkits typically support only a limited subset of techniques and use cases. We present SilverSpoon-KD, an open-source PyTorch toolkit that unifies different distillation paradigms and architectural relationships across workloads and applications behind a single API. Moreover, SilverSpoon-KD offers the first general-purpose blockwise knowledge distillation implementation with unique scalability features. We validate its versatility across vision, masked language model, and causal language models on tasks spanning homogeneous, heterogeneous, and quantization distillation across paradigms. We also evaluate SilverSpoon-KD by comparing its performance, including throughput and GPU memory usage, with existing toolkits. Despite extensive support for convenience, metric calculation, and tracking, we have found SilverSpoon-KD's performance to be on par with or better than existing toolkits.

AI.brief_summary: 提出开源 PyTorch 工具包 SilverSpoon-KD，用统一 API 覆盖多种知识蒸馏范式与师生架构关系，并提供首个通用 blockwise 蒸馏实现，在视觉、掩码语言模型与因果语言模型上验证吞吐和 GPU 显存等性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 其异构架构与逐块蒸馏实现可能为把教师中间表示或 latent 推理状态迁移到结构不同的学生模型提供工程线索，但是否支持推理轨迹级监督需核查。论文本身不涉及视觉推理。
